# Octavia Butler — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Octavia Butler known for?", "Kindred"),
    ("What field did Octavia Butler work in?", "science fiction"),
    ("What is lived?", "1947-2006"),
    ("What is field?", "science fiction"),
    ("What is known for?", "Kindred"),
    ("What is note?", "MacArthur genius; Afrofuturist pioneer"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
